svg.title: Price per kilogram for one verified dog food, cost per day not computed
svg.desc: A single bar for Kirkland Signature chicken, rice and vegetable dog food at 3.07 dollars per kilogram from a Costco same-day price of 55.60 dollars for 18.14 kilograms. Cost per day for a 25 kilogram dog is marked not computed because kilocalories and a feeding line were not on that page.
svg.text: Price per kilogram, not cost per day
Costco same-day, opened 26 Sep 2026. 55.60 divided by 18.14 kg rounds to 3.07 dollars.

g.text: 18.14 kg at 55.60 dollars. Out of stock on that page.
Not computed. No kcal or feeding line.

svg.text: Bar scale: 5.00 dollars per kg would be 400 px. 3.07 dollars is 246 px. Grey stubs are missing data, not zero prices.
Cost per day needs cups per day times grams per cup, from the same bag. Those lines were not on the priced listing.
Province was not named on the same-day listing. The Costco.ca item page said the product was not available.
Saving Optimizer, 26 Sep 2026. Recheck the tag. An out-of-stock price is not the next bag.
